purpose: Confirm that a WL3 claim missing execution fields downgrades to WL2 when the arguments commitment is present.

source_locators: Section 6.1 (XML anchor fields-conditional), WL2 and WL3 fields
Section 8.2.1 (XML anchor verifier-downgrade), explicit missing-execution example
Section 8.1 (XML anchor verifier-result), normative base and verdict calculation
steps: The host-hook boundary can ground WL3, but the required execution fields are absent.
The arguments hash satisfies the WL2 conditional requirement.
Core requires downgrade rather than rejection for this absence.
The highest supported level is WL2, so the verdict is downgrade.
